title: Turkey or Portugal for clothing production – how should a brand compare suppliers?
seoTitle: Turkey or Portugal for Clothing Production?
description: Compare two actual apparel suppliers using one design, the same reference samples and a common delivery destination. Weigh evidence for your particular order.
author: BEWE4R team
intro: Choose between suppliers in Turkey and Portugal by comparing what each can do with your garment. A country label will not tell you whether a workshop can match your washed fleece, grade an unusual sleeve or pack for your warehouse. Use the same test style and ask both suppliers to return evidence in a format your team can review together.

bodyHtml:
Make one product reveal the differences

Suppose a brand wants a zipped sweatshirt with a two-tone panel and a small embroidered wordmark. Send the same drawings, finished artwork dimensions and reference swatch to both suppliers. Ask each to identify the most uncertain detail. One might flag colour matching across different fibres. Another might ask how the embroidery behaves near the panel seam. Both are more useful observations than a general promise of quality.

What belongs on your comparison sheet?

QuestionEvidence you can compare fairly
Can the fit be reproduced?Sample, measurement sheet and explanation of the grading approach
Can the finish be repeated?Identified material and decoration trial, including any proposed substitution
Does the order suit the production route?Confirmed minimum by style and colour, responsibilities and revision process
Will it reach the same receiving point?Named destination, handover arrangement and documentary requirements checked for that route

Examine the finished trial under the same conditions and keep notes before you discuss preferences. If only one of the two samples uses the intended fabric, you can compare communication and construction progress. You cannot yet compare the finished drape on equal terms.

Check the route from the actual site

Ask where the relevant steps will take place and who can document them. A buyer receiving in Germany should confirm transport and import responsibilities for the actual origin and route with the appointed specialist. A UK buyer needs its own route review. Avoid assuming that a supplier’s address identifies every manufacturing step. EU information on trade with Türkiye

How can you compare a stock-fabric sample with a custom-fabric sample?

Start by marking everything the two trials genuinely share, such as the pocket construction or a pattern measurement. Compare those features now. For features that depend on the final cloth, request a swatch or equivalent trial from the supplier using a substitute. Keep your decision sheet open until you can judge the relevant feature under comparable conditions.

Decide where uncertainty is acceptable

For a repeat basic, reliable shade continuity may carry more weight than a particularly striking prototype. For a first seasonal piece, resolving a difficult construction issue before launch may matter most. Write the leading risk and the evidence that resolved it beside the supplier you select. Keep the same sheet for your next order.

If you are considering BEWE4R for your collection, send us the same garment specification and delivery destination. Ask us to identify which parts we can sample and which details need a trial before you choose a supplier.
